# Nara Day Trip — Draft Itinerary

**Overview**: Nara day trip, same-day return on 1 Dec 2026 | 0 nights, no hotel needed | light · standard · standard · light

*Note: your request doesn't say where you're starting from. The draft below assumes you come from Kyoto (approx. 45 min by Kintetsu); if you're based in Osaka, the Osaka-Namba route is approx. 40 min — tell me and I'll adjust.*

**Before you go**
- Get an IC card (ICOCA / Suica / PASMO) — works on Kintetsu, JR and city buses.
- Check the Kintetsu limited express reserved-seat option if you want to sit on the way in; ordinary trains are fine too.
- Many temples in Nara close around 16:30–17:00 in winter — please check each one before you go.
- Early December is quiet compared with autumn-leaf season, but Todai-ji is busy from mid-morning: arrive early.
- No reservation-only sites are needed for this plan; if you want a guided Todai-ji talk, book a few weeks ahead (please check).

**Day 1 | Kyoto → Nara Park → Naramachi → back (light · standard · standard · light)**
- 08:00 Kintetsu Kyoto Station → Kintetsu-Nara, approx. 45 min, no transfer (limited express slightly faster); Kintetsu-Nara is the closest station to the park
- 09:00 Walk approx. 10 min to Kofuku-ji — five-storey pagoda and hall, quiet at this hour
- 10:00 Walk approx. 15 min through Nara Park to Todai-ji; Great Buddha Hall (Daibutsuden) — go before the tour groups build up
- 11:30 Walk approx. 10 min up to Nigatsu-do for the view over the park; short rest
- 12:30 Lunch near Nara Park / Kasuga area, approx. 1 h
- 14:00 Walk approx. 20 min (uphill) to Kasuga Taisha — lantern-lined approach; deer crackers are sold on the way, keep bags and snacks out of reach
- 15:30 Walk approx. 20 min down to Naramachi — old merchant streets, cafes, a slow wander
- 17:00 Early dinner in Naramachi, then walk approx. 15 min back to Kintetsu-Nara
- 18:30 Kintetsu-Nara → Kyoto Station, approx. 45 min, no transfer
- Alternatives: if rain, Nara National Museum and the indoor Great Buddha Hall instead of the park walk; if tired, drop Nigatsu-do and Naramachi and head back after Kasuga Taisha
- No overnight stay — same-day return, so no hotel is booked. (Live hotel data wasn't searched because you're not staying overnight.)

Want me to rework the timings around an Osaka start, or add Horyu-ji (approx. 15 min by JR from JR Nara plus a walk or bus)?
